steps.body: Counting to 29, then one more, is tricky. The 9 rolls back to 0 and the ten goes up: 30.
steps.narration: Counting to twenty-nine, then one more, is tricky. The nine rolls back to zero and the ten goes up: thirty.

widget.prompt: Start at 27 and count on 4. Cross into the 30s. Tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That's 5 hops. Count just 4 from 27 to land on 31.

predict.prompt: Start at 27 and count on 4. Which family of numbers will you finish in?
predict.reveal: Three counts reach 30, and one more step carries you into the thirties — counting on can cross into the next decade.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents count sequence.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for count sequence must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines count sequence.

concept.body: Slow it down. A number ending in 9 is the last of its ten. After 19 comes 20. After 29 comes 30.
concept.narration: A number ending in nine is the last of its ten. After nineteen comes twenty. After twenty-nine comes thirty.
